defs.def: thin, in a way that is attractive 人

ex.s: If he can eat much and keep slim, why can’t I?
ex.t: 如果他能吃很多还保持苗条，为什么我不能呢？

ex.s: How slim we want to be.
She still has smooth skin and straight black hair, and jogging has kept her slim and fit.
ex.t: 她依然皮肤光滑、一头顺直的黑发，慢跑让她保持苗条健美。

ex.s: So, ever since I discovered selfie apps that could remove my freckles, enlarge my eyes and even slim my jawline, I have become addicted.
ex.t: 因此，自从我发现可以去除雀斑、放大眼睛甚至缩短下巴线的自拍应用程序以来，我已经上瘾了。

ex.s: Because of the weather and very little knowledge of how to survive in the Antarctic, the chances of success were quite slim and many explorers died.
ex.t: 由于天气恶劣，对如何在南极生存知之甚少，成功的机会相当渺茫，许多探险家死亡。

ex.s: Indeed, his slim but strong body was just like that of millions of Chinese farmers, to whom he had devoted his life.
ex.t: 事实上，他苗条而强壮的身体就像数以百万计的中国农民一样，他为之奉献了一生。

ex.s: To be sure, more than half of teens still engage in these activities, but the ___44___ have slimmed considerably, Between 1976 and 1979, 86 percent of high school seniors had gone on a date; between 2010 and 2015 only 63 percent People say, Oh, it's because teenagers are more responsible, or more lazy, or more boring, “but they're ___45___ the larger trend,” said Jean Twenge, lead author of the study, which drew on seven large time-lag surveys of Americans.
ex.t: 诚然，超过半数青少年仍参与这些活动，但___44___已大幅缩减。1976至1979年间，86%的高中生曾约会；2010至2015年间仅63%。人们说，哦，这是因为青少年更负责、或更懒、或更无趣，“但他们___45___更大的趋势，”该研究领衔作者珍·特温格说，研究借鉴了七项美国大型时滞调查。

defs.def: not as big as you would like or expect 微薄的；不足的；少的；小的

ex.s: I see what you mean, but … GOING POSITIVE I always wanted to look like the slim girls on TV even though I knew that it was impossible.
ex.t: 我明白你的意思，但是……保持积极的态度，我一直想看起来像电视上的苗条女孩，尽管我知道这是不可能的。
